material.title: Large preregistered trial finds brief online CBT reduces adolescent depressive symptoms at 12 months
material.bodyOriginal: In a preregistered randomized controlled trial of 2,400 adolescents across 40 schools, an 8-week online CBT programme reduced PHQ-9 scores compared with usual care at 12-month follow-up (d = 0.31, 95% CI 0.22-0.40). Effects were smaller in students with severe baseline symptoms. Data and code are openly available.

material.title: 7 个信号说明你是讨好型人格，第 5 个太扎心
material.bodyZh: 你是不是总是不敢拒绝别人？心理学研究表明，讨好型人格的人往往有这 7 个特点……想彻底摆脱讨好，欢迎报名我们的 21 天心理成长营。
